port.description: The TCP port on which the Gophernicus server listens for incoming connections.

host.description: The local IP address or hostname the server binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

root.description: The filesystem path to the directory served as the Gopher root.

maxconn.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections. Set to 0 for no limit.

timeout.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds before closing.

syslog.description: If true, log messages to the system syslog daemon.

log_to_file.description: If true, write access logs to a file instead of (or in addition to) syslog.

logfile.description: Path to the log file used when log_to_file is enabled.

dirindex.description: If true, automatically generate directory listings for browsable Gopher directories.

server_descriptions.description: A list of short descriptive lines shown on the server info (info.gopher) page.

servername.description: The public name of this Gopher server (used in banners, info pages, and server responses).

vhostprefix.description: Virtual host prefix (e.g., 'gopher.example.com/') if supported by compiled version; leave empty to disable.

mime_overrides.description: List of file extension → MIME type mappings for custom type handling.

mime.description: MIME type for that extension, e.g. 'text/html'.

default_mime.description: MIME type assigned to files without a known extension or override.

banned_ips.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges to block from accessing the server.

items.description: An IPv4 address (e.g., '192.168.1.100') or CIDR block (e.g., '10.0.0.0/24').

whitelist_mode.description: If true, block all IPs except those explicitly listed in 'banned_ips' (i.e., treat banned_ips as a whitelist).

no_dirlist.description: If true, suppress directory listings even when DIRINDEX is enabled (e.g., for read-only or hidden directories).

hide_dotfiles.description: If true, hide files and directories whose names start with a dot (.) in directory listings.

log_ip.description: If true, include client IP addresses in log output (for debugging and security auditing).
